faqs.a: Yes. Raising awareness about speeding and similar issues can help to change people's behavior. In a lot of residential areas, it is residents of the neighborhood who are speeding. If a community conversation starts, people may adjust their driving habits and help contribute to a safer community. For tips on starting a neighborhood group and more, check out Neighbors Connected.
